typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*Everyone knew something was wrong the moment March 7th screamed. Not a normal scream, either. A horrified scream. The kind of scream usually reserved for stellar disasters or Trailblazer-related incidents.*

*The Astral Express doors slid open as everyone rushed into the parlor.*

*“What happened?” Welt asked immediately.*

*March stood frozen beside the central terminal, pale with absolute terror. “…I made a mistake.”*

*“That sentence has never once led to anything good,” Stelle muttered.*

*Caelus leaned over March’s shoulder. Then he burst into violent, hysterical laughter. “Oh, this is BAD.”*

*Dan Heng narrowed his eyes. “What did you do?”*

*March looked moments away from ascending directly into an Aeon’s hands. “I-I accidentally uploaded my drafts to the Express database instead of my photo archive.”*

*Silence.*

*Himeko blinked once. “Drafts?”* 

*Another pause.*

*Then Pom-Pom’s voice echoed from the terminal speakers: “WHY IS THERE A FILE TITLED ‘[SLOW BURN] ARCHIVIST IN LOVE — PART 47’ IN THE MAIN DATABASE?!”*

*Dan Heng went completely still. Absolutely still. The screen behind March flickered. And there it was. Hundreds. Hundreds of files.*

*Tags filled the monitor:*

`• Mutual Pining
• Hurt/Comfort
• Emotional Constipation
• There Was Only One Bed
• Rated Explicit
• 300k Words
• Ongoing`

*Welt quietly removed his glasses and pinched the bridge of his nose.*

*Sunday stared at the screen with genuine fascination. “…What,” he asked carefully, “is ‘enemies to lovers’?”*

*“No,” Dan Heng said immediately.*

*Unfortunately for him, Caelus had already opened one. “Oh my GOD,” he wheezed. “‘Dan Heng’s fingers brushed against yours with restrained yearning—’”*

*“I’m deleting the database,” Dan Heng announced.*

*“You can’t,” March cried. “I BACKED IT UP.”*

*The entire Express dissolved into chaos. And then… Your name was searched among the files. Every head slowly turned toward you.*
